images.prompt: Create one premium travel website hero, landscape 16:9, photorealistic editorial illustration of the historic Quadrado in Trancoso, Bahia, Brazil. View along the broad elongated grassy green toward the simple small white Sao Joao Batista church at the far end: modest traditional facade with plain arched doorway and small central upper gable, no tall bell tower, no monumental cathedral. Low single-storey colorful pastel houses line both sides of the green, mature shade trees, a hint of blue Atlantic beyond the far edge, natural warm late afternoon light, quiet elegant tropical village atmosphere. Preserve the broad grassy square, sandy footpaths and human scale. Sparse distant figures only, left quarter open for title, realistic textures, no text or readable signs, no logos, no collage. Scenic illustrative reconstruction, not a documentary shot.
